name: Jade Teapot
description: One pot, one world, one leaf, one Bodhi. For thousands of years, the appearance of jade pots has often been freehand in shape, engraved with landscape figures, various flower patterns or bas-reliefs with Yangwen poems, etc. The artistry and humanism have been continuously improved. Pinku Design launches the metal assembled "Jade Pot", using metal materials to continue the artistic charm of the jade pot.
